messages.author: b952ca0661f22880
messages.subject: Freely estimate latent means
parts:
Hi all: How can I free the latent mean at times 2 and 3 when I have constrained the intercepts across times to be equal? Here's my syntax - I'm stuck on how to free Accept2, Accept3, Reject2, and Reject3:

strong.model <- '
#latent variables
Accept1 =~ L1*Acc11 + L2*Acc21 + L3*Acc31
Accept2 =~ L1*Acc12 + L2*Acc22 + L3*Acc32
Accept3 =~ L1*Acc13 + L2*Acc23 + L3*Acc33
Reject1 =~ L4*Rej11 + L5*Rej21 + L6*Rej31
Reject2 =~ L4*Rej12 + L5*Rej22 + L6*Rej32
Reject3 =~ L4*Rej13 + L5*Rej23 + L6*Rej33
#LV variances
Accept1 ~~ 1*Accept1
Accept2 ~~ NA*Accept2
Accept3 ~~ NA*Accept3
Reject1 ~~ 1*Reject1
Reject2 ~~ NA*Reject2
Reject3 ~~ NA*Reject3
#residual covariances
Acc11 ~~ Acc12
Acc11 ~~ Acc13
Acc12 ~~ Acc13
Acc21 ~~ Acc22
Acc21 ~~ Acc23
Acc22 ~~ Acc23
Acc31 ~~ Acc32
Acc31 ~~ Acc33
Acc32 ~~ Acc33
Acc11 ~~ Acc12
Acc11 ~~ Acc13
Rej11 ~~ Rej12
Rej11 ~~ Rej13
Rej12 ~~ Rej13
Rej21 ~~ Rej22
Rej21 ~~ Rej23
Rej22 ~~ Rej23
Rej31 ~~ Rej32
Rej31 ~~ Rej33
Rej32 ~~ Rej33
#intercepts
Acc11 ~ a1*1 
Acc12 ~ a2*1
Acc13 ~ a3*1
Acc21 ~ a1*1
Acc22 ~ a2*1
Acc23 ~ a3*1
Acc31 ~ a1*1
Acc32 ~ a2*1
Acc33 ~ a3*1
Rej11 ~ a4*1 
Rej12 ~ a5*1
Rej13 ~ a6*1
Rej21 ~ a4*1
Rej22 ~ a5*1
Rej23 ~ a6*1
Rej31 ~ a4*1
Rej32 ~ a5*1
Rej33 ~ a6*1'
#Accept2 ~ NA*1
#Accept3 ~ NA*1
#Reject2 ~ NA*1
#Reject3 ~ NA*1'

#fitting  the cfa for the initial cfa model
fit <- cfa(strong.model, sample.cov=family.cov, sample.mean=family.mean, sample.nobs=368, std.lv=TRUE, meanstructure=TRUE)
summary(fit, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE)

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Freely estimate latent means
parts: Unfortunately, when I uncomment those lines, the model doesn't converge (but it does in other SEM packages -- like Mplus).
Because you haven't specified constraints on the intercepts properly, as you have on the loadings.

#intercepts
Acc11 ~ a1*1 
Acc12 ~ a2*1
Acc13 ~ a3*1
Acc21 ~ a1*1
Acc22 ~ a2*1
Acc23 ~ a3*1
Acc31 ~ a1*1
Acc32 ~ a2*1
Acc33 ~ a3*1
Rej11 ~ a4*1 
Rej12 ~ a5*1
Rej13 ~ a6*1
Rej21 ~ a4*1
Rej22 ~ a5*1
Rej23 ~ a6*1
Rej31 ~ a4*1
Rej32 ~ a5*1
Rej33 ~ a6*1'

According to your latent-variable definitions, the first subscript is what varies across items, the second subscript varies across occasions.  So it should be like this:

Acc11 ~ a1*1
Acc12 ~ a1*1
Acc13 ~ a1*1
Acc21 ~ a2*1
Acc22 ~ a2*1
Acc23 ~ a2*1
...


Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
UvA web page: http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
